text: Every dive loads the hull with that enormous pressure, and every ascent releases it. Each cycle can grow tiny damage. A gap between layers. A weak spot in the glue. Titan had sensors to listen for cracking, meant to warn the pilot in time to head back up. But a warning only helps if there's time to act, and if someone decides to stop. On a dive in twenty twenty-two, the people aboard heard a loud bang. Investigators later concluded the hull was most likely damaged around then. It kept diving.
